summary_1line: Ghatotkacha and other Rakshasas carry the Pandavas through wondrous lands to the sacred hermitage of Nara and Narayana near Mount Kailasa.

image_candidates.scene_text: Ghatotkacha lifts Draupadi onto his shoulders while other Rakshasas bear the Pandavas through the sky over forests and mountains.
The Pandavas arrive before the vast honey-dropping jujube tree beside Mount Kailasa, surrounded by sages and celestial birds.
Yudhishthira approaches the radiant hermitage of Nara and Narayana where ascetic sages chant the Vedas amid sacrificial fires.
